reviewItem.question: Does "add terminationGracePeriod RBAC permissions (#6538) #6538 (Nick Tran)" mean a change to rbac-permission:karpenter|name=terminationGracePeriod (added)?

proposed.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 adds "terminationGracePeriod RBAC permissions" (bug fix, PR #6538) to the product's controller RBAC; the release note names no specific resource, verb, role, or consequence beyond the addition.
